sites.name: Efkirekeb Zdaw, the Valley Watchtower
sites.storm: storm-dusk at its worst: dust sheets and gusts; cloth and tarps flap (WPO); dust drifts on the lee side of walls; landmarks must read as silhouettes through 3 km transmittance ~0.15 haze
sites.story: none (quiet stretch): the silhouette seen from the Waiting Water; marks the ridge grade
sites.style: BAZAAR STONE: a broken watchtower shell in a stepped yard; collapse spills toward the road

sites.notes: V2 prototype 2026-09-29 (the author: V1 "looks ugly": clean tower block + flat slabs on grass). Kit-built shell of uneven height, collapsed road-side corner, stepped yard wall with a lintel gate, every base in rubble and creep, one leaning dead tree and stumps. Editor follow-up: the landscape dead-tree scatter inside radius_m must be cleared by the PB_FoliageExclude tags or by hand.
